text:
maya.dev: quick async standup — samplekit & quickstarts
what I did: polished SampleKit node quickstart, clarified the build steps in README, removed the outdated `npm link` step and added `npm ci` note. I also updated the example app to use the new streaming API. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/pull/482 :party:
blockers: macOS wheels CI is flaky again — failing on `native-binding` during install on M1 runners, reproduces locally on my laptop.
plan/today: open follow-up PR to pin the wheel build, triage CI with infra, and land the docs change if CI looks green.

samir: looking now — can you paste the failing log snippet? I might have seen this with the build image change last week.

maya.dev: sure — log is small, pasted here:
```
ERROR: Could not build wheels for native-binding which use PEP 517 and cannot be installed directly
clang: error: unsupported option '-march=skylake' for target 'arm64-apple-darwin'
```

lee: @maya.dev I hit that yesterday. Temporary workaround was to force-build on `ubuntu-latest` matrix for wheels and upload universal binary. Not ideal but unblocks. I'll open a tiny CI patch to skip mac wheels for now.

alex.r: pinging infra about M1 runner image mismatch — @infra-team can you check if XCode/clang flags got updated in the build image?

doc-bot: CI docs-check — samplekit README change passed spellcheck, link-check failing on an external redirect (third_party.example.com).

samir: thanks — maya, if you can change the quickstart to suggest `npm ci` and include a short note about M1 quirks that should reduce footguns. I'll review the PR today.

maya.dev: will do, adding the note and bumping the PR. Also: small docs ask — can someone proof the new streaming example? It's a tiny code snippet using `redwood.stream()` and function-calling shape.

lee: I can eyeball it. Paste snippet here and I'll sanity-check for JS style.

maya.dev: snippet below:
```js
const resp = await redwood.stream({ model: 'rw-infer/mega', prompt: 'Summarize', onData: (chunk) => process.stdout.write(chunk) })
```

lee: looks good, maybe add `await resp.done()` or clarify cleanup for the KV cache in comments.

alex.r: quick FYI — I left a small comment on the sampleapp PR about replacing hardcoded API key with env var usage and added a test case suggestion for the streaming path.

maya.dev: thanks all. Action items: (1) maya—update PR with `npm ci` note + streaming clarification, (2) lee—open temp CI patch to skip mac wheel uploads, (3) alex—confirm env var change + test case, (4) samir—review docs PR. If CI still noisy after these, I'll schedule a short async thread with infra. :thumbsup:

samir: acked.

lee: acked, will do patch by EOD.

alex.r: acked, will add tests early afternoon.

maya.dev: cool, thanks team — will update thread when PR is ready.
